These queries are untested guesses written from the documentation page alone. Two assumptions carry the most risk:

- **Rounding (H2, H10):** the page lists no rounding verb, so `round 2` and `round 1` are guesses that such a verb exists.
- **`coalesce` and `groupBy`:** I assumed `coalesce x` replaces a null with `x`, and that `groupBy` accepts keyword keys.

H1: filter ~(if /active ~(if (/country | lower | eq "de") ~(if (at :age | type | eq ::number) ~(/age | gte 30) ~(false)) ~(false)) ~(false)) * /name | sort
H2: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") * (/items * (mul /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2
H3: groupBy ~(/customer | lower | keyword) * count
H4: {:name /name :depCount (/dependencies | count) :devDepCount (/devDependencies | count) :scripts (/scripts | keys * keyword | sort)}
H5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | mul -1) /id]) | take 3 * /id
H6: * (at :labels | coalesce []) | flat * lower | distinct | sort
H7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(at :assignee | if (type | eq ::map) ~(/login) ~("unassigned") | keyword) * count
H8: lines | filter ~(split "" | count | gt 0) * split " " | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2 | keyword) * count
H9: lines | filter ~(split "" | count | gt 0) * split " " | filter ~(if (/1 | eq "ERROR") ~(true) ~(/1 | eq "WARN")) * (drop 3 | filter ~(startsWith "user=")) | flat * (split "=" | /1) | distinct | sort
H10: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(split "" | count | gt 0) * split "," | filter ~(if (/4 | lower | eq "up") ~(/2 | eq "" | not) ~(false)) | groupBy ~(/1 | keyword) * (* (/2 | parseJson) | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | round 1)
H11: lines | filter ~(split "" | count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(split "=" | first | lower | startsWith "db_") * {:k (split "=" | first | lower | split "_" | drop 1 | join "_" | keyword) :v (split "=" | drop 1 | join "=")} | indexBy ~/k * /v
H12: :d /defaults/timeout | /services | filter ~(/enabled) * {:name /name :timeout (at :timeout | coalesce d) :team (at :owner | if (type | eq ::map) ~(at :team | coalesce "none") ~("none"))} | sort ~/name
H13: /results | filter ~(if (at :score | type | eq ::number) ~(/score | gte 50) ~(false)) | sort ~/score | reverse * ([([/profile/first /profile/last] | join " ") (at :tags | coalesce [] | join "|")] | join ": ")
H14: "The cat saw the dog; a Dog saw THE cat and a bird. Bird, dog!" | lower | split "" | filter ~(:c / | if (eq " ") ~(true) ~(lower | eq (c | upper) | not)) | join "" | split " " | filter ~(split "" | count | gt 0) | :ws / | distinct * (:w / | {:word w :count (ws | filter ~(eq w) | count)}) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /word]) | take 3
